title: Virgo's 3 AM pros and cons
old_caption:
Long list of pros, and the only con is that you're scared?
Scared isn't a con. It means it matters.

title: Libra moves the couch for a date night in
old_caption:
Moving the whole room around before they come over?
They're coming to see you, not the couch.

title: Scorpio writes it on the frosty window
old_caption:
Some feelings show up at 3 AM and want to be said right now.
Wait for daylight, then say it simply.

title: Sag plans a second date across three mountains
old_caption:
Planning a three-mountain trip for a second date?
Big plans can wait. Start with a walk in the snow.

title: Capricorn writes next year's goals
old_caption:
Writing next year's goals and the people end up last?
Move them to the top of the list.

title: Aquarius wants to share the winter sky
old_caption:
Clear winter sky, and one name comes to mind first.
That name counts. Tell them tomorrow.

title: Pisces gets a 3 AM text from a friend
old_caption:
Awake at 3 AM, and it turns out a friend is too.
Long nights are easier together. Check on your people.

title: Left on Read
old_caption:
Left on read again and already rewriting the whole story?
Silence isn't a verdict. Put the phone down and go live your day.

title: Their Song Came On
old_caption:
When their song comes on in the middle of the grocery store.
Let yourself feel it all the way. You just don't have to text it.

title: The 2 a.m. Paragraph
old_caption:
Typing a paragraph at 2 a.m.? Same.
Save it as a draft and read it at noon. If it still feels true, it'll keep.
